name: Adult Time
summary: Gamma Entertainment's flagship streaming hub bundling 300+ channels (Pure Taboo, Girlsway, 21Sextury, Transfixed, Vivid) into a modern Netflix-style library.
ranking_rationale: Best overall value-per-dollar in premium streaming: marries a genuinely modern Netflix-style interface with massive channel breadth and acclaimed original series.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; one subscription unlocks hundreds of partner channels and originals. Check official checkout.

pros: Hundreds of studios and channels included under one subscription
Modern streaming UI with watchlists, series episodes, and smart search
Acclaimed original lines including Pure Taboo, Girlsway, and Transfixed
Strong inclusivity across straight, lesbian, trans, and niche lines
cons: Vast catalog mixes brand-new 4K originals with older partner archives
Some add-on partner networks still cost extra depending on plan
Trial terms auto-renew at standard rates if not cancelled

facts.value: Launched 2019 by Gamma Entertainment (CCO Bree Mills)
Single subscription unlocking 300+ channels and original series
Netflix-style streaming platform with episodic original productions
